About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• 
Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• 
Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• 
Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• 
Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• 
Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• 
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• 
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• 
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• 
Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• 
Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• 
Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

You likely bring:

• 
7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• 
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• 
The ability to break down complex problems into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs

• 
Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines

• 
A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• 
Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

• 
Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• 
Java, Spring Boot, JUnit

• 
MySQL, Flyway, SQS

• 
REST APIs

• 
Domain Driven Design

• 
Docker, Terraform, AWS ECS

• 
Ports and adapters architecture

Why Flatpay

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

What You Will Do

You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

What You Could Bring

This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

How We Work

You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. The innovative dual-lense camera technology records the entire pitch at all times, with two 4K high resolution sports action lenses. Our intelligent software automatically follows the ball to create a broadcast view, while allowing you the controls with a simple click of you mouse. Our solution is developing better athletes. We know players are visual learners, seeing themselves play rather than being told of their mistakes is more effective and likely to produce results.

You will work closely with engineers, designers, operations, commercial teams, and external partners to turn customer needs, business priorities, and technical requirements into clear product improvements. What you will work on

Turn customer feedback, product and user data, and business needs into well-defined product improvements.

Work closely with other product managers, designers, and engineers throughout product discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration.

Who you are

You're proactive, structured, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. You take a hands-on approach and are willing to step into the details when needed. You can work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and move initiatives forward while keeping relevant colleagues informed and aligned.

You enjoy working closely with engineers, designers, and commercial teams, and you can turn complex requirements into practical product improvements. You combine customer focus with clear communication across different functions, and use evidence to make informed decisions.

What we are looking for

Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical trade-offs related to app development.

Strong collaboration skills and experience working with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

Ability to balance customer needs with technical, operational, commercial, and relevant regulatory considerations.

A structured and analytical approach, with confidence using product data and customer insight to guide decisions.

Practical experience applying AI tools to product discovery, analysis, or delivery is an advantage.

Willingness and ability to travel occasionally across Flatpay’s markets.

Professional-level English proficiency.

Why Flatpay?

Making life easier for SMEs is at the core of Flatpay’s work. As we continue to grow, our financial services help small and medium-sized businesses manage their finances and run their businesses more effectively. You'll help shape a banking product that is an important part of that experience.

Flatpay has more than 2,500 employees across seven markets. We value work-life balance, creativity, and collaboration, and you will join a supportive product environment with room to take initiative, learn, and improve how we serve our customers. Our Herlev office also offers an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room, free slush ice, and other ways to enjoy life at the office.

Reporting to the Product Director, you'll contribute to a banking product that supports Flatpay’s continued growth in financial services. This position is based in our Herlev office.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you!

Help shape the future of medical dermatology by building trusted partnerships and delivering meaningful business results across Denmark.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact.  Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy, and Environmental Medicine at the Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health, University of Southern Denmark, is offering a new 5-year (20%) position for an Associate Professor within clinical pharmacy. The position is to be filled from February 1st, 2027.

The academic position

The research areas of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM) span from pharmacological epidemiology to clinical studies and cell-based basic pharmacology. CPPEM has a strong background in investigations of exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. The academic position is affiliated with the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, that utilizes the Danish registries to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. 

The area of research is flexible within the area of pharmacoepidemiologic and clinical research and could be (but is not limited to) drug use patterns and rational pharmacotherapy. The department has a strong focus on interdisciplinary collaboration both in-house and with external researchers and the new person is expected to continue this tradition.
 

Areas of responsibility

The applicant will be expected to establish their own research area within the pharmacoepidemiologic research group at the department. Thus, the applicant should be able to attract external research funding to support research and employ scientific and technical staff. The applicant may have a background within pharmacy or medicine.

The research unit teaches in four educations: Medicine, Pharmacy, Chiropractor, and Biomedicine, and the position comes with teaching obligations within these subjects at the University as well as supervision of bachelor and master projects. Additionally, we expect that you will contribute to administrative duties, e.g., participating in Study Board or other similar activities. 

Fluent English (both written and spoken) is required. You are expected to have qualifications that renders it probable that you will be able to establish your own research area within the research unit. Further, you are required to have a PhD degree or similar research experience. 
 

Employers

Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine today has approximately 50 employees. It consists of three separate research groups: pharmacoepidemiology, translational pharmacology, and environmental medicine. Additionally, it collaborates closely with the Department of Pharmacology at OUH. Collectively, this constitutes Denmark’s largest center for research, teaching and clinical service in pharmacology.

It produces approximately 100 international peer-reviewed publications per year. 

Professor Tore B. Stage heads the unit and Professor Pernille Tanggaard Andersen heads the Department.

Management

The Associate Professor answers to the research leader for the unit of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine.
 

Contact information

Further information can be obtained from the leader for the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, Professor Anton Pottegård (apottegaard@health.sdu.dk).
 

Application deadline and interviews

November 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. CET
 

Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the university.

Applications – including the required attachments – must be sent via the below-mentioned link “Apply online". Only online applications will be accepted. Attached files must be Adobe PDF or Word format. Each field in the application form can contain up to max. 10 MB.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.
 

Application (as pdf- or Word/docx- files):

• 
a motivation letter

• 
a detailed CV

• 
degree certificates (inclusive of PhD diploma)

• 
a complete and numbered list of publications

• 
10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please notice that one pdf- or docx- file must be attached for each publication

• 
a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

• 
a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

References will be obtained for the applicant who is the first choice for the position – from the applicant’s most recent employer and previous employers as required.

Further particulars concerning the application – please see the link below.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
